messages.author: 7ede0ff22239b30a
messages.subject: Model with binary endogenous variable
parts:
Hey,

I have a model with one continuous DV and one binary DV. 

Do I have to use the ", ordered = ("binary_dv")" function? 
Also, when reading the results, how do I get the odds ratios for the different predictors?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Model with binary endogenous variable
parts: Do I have to use the ", ordered = ("binary_dv")" function?
That is an argument you should use; otherwise, the binary values are treated as a continuum, violating the normality assumption.
Also, when reading the results, how do I get the odds ratios for the different predictors?

You don't.  lavaan does not provide logistic-regression models, only probit models (i.e., assuming normality of an underlying latent response).
